_readme: Creator farms for What to farm today (core/src/strategies.rs), from .claude/atlas-research/report_new_since_22nov.md (26 Nov 2026).
A run = one map (or one chain / one fight). loot: items priced live from poe.ninja (average of the names found), per run, times sell (what you get after selling slowly or under poe.ninja).
other_div: the creator's other loot per run in divines (gold, Lost Shipments, invitations…): their total minus the key items, so it stays put when prices move.
jackpot lines are rare big drops: shown apart, with a 'needs a big sample' badge instead of a plain div an hour.
costs: map (item name, or map_chaos), roll_chaos, threads [name, a run], vaal (Vaal Orbs a run), entry [item, a run].
ask: what Farm this asks the atlas builder for (atlas_opt::Ask).

strategies.title: Vaal Temple boss rush
strategies.how: Buy Vaal Temple maps, run straight to the boss and leave. Lost in Transit and ore on the way, Exarch altars, Mirage copies the boss.

loot.label: Vaal boss fragment
loot.note: Vascor: one ~8 div drop from about 15% of temples. We price it as a Soul Core, the ~8 div Vaal drop on poe.ninja; check the name in game.

source.said: about 70 div an hour after 9,000c of temples

strategies.title: Sanctuary vault rush
strategies.how: Rush Sanctuary Nightmare maps to the boss for its three fragments; the anomaly nodes open a vault (Atlas Anomaly) in about half of them. One Abyss, Bestiary and Ritual Thread only for Multiplying Modifiers.

source.sample: 29 vaults in 50 maps; Headhunter, Mageblood and 2 House of Mirrors in 100 maps (lucky)
source.said: no div an hour; we count half his jackpots, and the fragments at about 44c each

strategies.title: Catarina medallions
strategies.how: Use Syndicate Medallions to fight Catarina again and again; her loot pays back the medallion and more. Rarity, explicit effect, shrines and Mirage on the tree.

source.sample: 50 medallions: 20 returned 98 div (lucky), 30 more about 30 div an hour
source.said: about 30 div an hour when medallions were 2.9 div; Hayura's Syndicate Nightmare maps made about 27 div an hour after costs

strategies.title: Reverence memory chain
strategies.how: A Memory of Reverence opens 4-6 maps to Theater of Lies, which drops an Echo of Reverence. Roll a guaranteed-Mirage mod on the last map for a second Echo. The Maven witnesses for invitations and chisels.

loot.label: Echo of Reverence
loot.note: One Echo, two with the Mirage on the last map.

source.sample: no itemised log, 4-5 chains an hour

strategies.title: Essences + Crystal Resonance
strategies.how: Alch-and-go T16 maps with every essence node: 6-7 essence monsters a map, and Crystal Resonance gives the boss a copy of each. Corrupt them with Vaal Orbs. Three cheapest Threads for Multiplying Modifiers.

strategies.title: 1-Thread alch-and-go Threads
strategies.how: Alch-and-go Dunes with one Abyss Thread and every Thread node: rares drop Threads (Legion sells best), plus Fates. Cheap to run.

source.said: 35 div, about 15 div an hour after 475c of costs; a third of it was Threads
